portal-heading.purpose: Weekly Plan, Connect and Profile page titles below 640px; scoped extension of the existing serif hierarchy.

portal-heading-wide.purpose: Weekly Plan, Connect and Profile page titles from 640px.

public-display.purpose: Two masked hero title lines above 1050px, in self-hosted Barlow Condensed semibold, declared as RC Display.

public-display-compact.purpose: Landing title at 1050px and below, overridden by the mobile ramp at 760px.

public-display-mobile.purpose: Landing title on the theme ground below its photographic band.

public-section-heading.purpose: Example plan and setup story headings; mobile uses clamp(2.75rem, 10vw, 4rem).

public-login-heading.purpose: One task heading beside the track photograph; mobile uses clamp(3rem, 10vw, 4rem).

public-brand.purpose: RC Display wordmark beside the shared track mark, with scoped small-screen/footer sizes.

public-action-label.purpose: DM Sans labels on square actions, including Google sign-in.

shadows.name: portal-elevation
shadows.purpose: Scoped Connect provider and Profile editor surfaces; preserves unrelated global elevation.

motion.name: portal-state-transition
motion.purpose: Connect and Profile controls; removed under prefers-reduced-motion. Navigation uses 160ms color/background transitions and the shell uses 160ms opacity with 4px translation, disabled with useReducedMotion.

motion.name: public-ease
motion.purpose: Scoped photo shutter, title, action and native photo-route transition easing.

motion.name: public-photo-shutter
motion.purpose: Visible photographs animate once on 18% viewport intersection, including below-fold images. Reduced motion retains the final state.

motion.name: public-title-mask
motion.purpose: Two landing title lines rise through separate masks. Reduced motion starts at the final state.

motion.name: public-content-entrance
motion.value: opacity:0.4 to 1; 450ms; default delay:300ms; login delay:160ms
motion.purpose: Quieter supporting copy/action entrance; reduced motion starts fully visible.

motion.name: public-week-selection
motion.purpose: Shared-layout selected-day fill. Reduced motion removes layoutId and layout travel.

motion.name: public-session-change
motion.purpose: Selected example-session details; reduced motion starts at the final state.

motion.name: public-control-feedback
motion.purpose: Square public action feedback. Opacity uses 180ms ease; weekday color uses 160ms ease. Reduced-motion CSS removes transitions.

motion.name: public-native-route-transition
motion.purpose: Progressive native same-document route transition after flushed navigation and destination-photo decode. Modified clicks, unsupported browsers and reduced motion retain ordinary link behavior.

motion.name: public-pending-spinner
motion.purpose: OAuth/session-check pending only. Reduced-motion CSS disables spinning while labels and status stay visible.

breakpoints.name: public-narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Maximum width: compact wordmark/nav, textless labelled home control, smaller day padding and next-step spacing.

breakpoints.name: public-mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Maximum width: 76px masthead, separate hero photo band, stacked plan/story/login, 180px Login photo and wrapped footer credits.

breakpoints.name: public-compact
breakpoints.purpose: Maximum width: four-column weekday strip with session names, session note below, compact hero ramp and tighter photo/content gaps.

publicGeometry.hero: width:calc(100% - 48px); max-width:1440px; min-height:560px; height:min(720px,calc(100svh - 130px)); copy width:46%; monochrome photograph with neutral black scrim increasing from 5% over athletes to 56% behind copy
publicGeometry.heroMobile: at max-width:760px width:calc(100% - 40px); height:auto; photo height:clamp(240px,54vw,370px); full-width copy below; no scrim
publicGeometry.weekdayStrip: 7 columns above 1050px; 4 at max-width:1050px; gap:4px; session names visible at every width
publicGeometry.plan: content/photo columns:1.9fr 0.85fr, then 1.6fr 0.8fr at max-width:1050px; stacked at max-width:760px with 240px photo
publicGeometry.sessionDetail: 2 columns:1fr 1fr; note right spanning both rows; at max-width:1050px prescription beside heading and note below
publicGeometry.story: 2 equal columns with track photo and setup content; normal flow; photo height:720px,780px at max-width:1050px,320px at max-width:760px
publicGeometry.close: action-color field with heading beside inverse action; stack at max-width:760px
publicGeometry.login: columns:0.95fr 1fr; form max-width:29rem; photo height:min(690px,calc(100svh - 200px)) with min-height:560px; at max-width:760px stacked with 180px photo and 34rem form cap
publicGeometry.photography: Fitsum Admasu training group, Jakob Owens runner by the water, Filip Mroz track stride; local WebP assets, source links in footer and provenance/license in src/assets/public/README.md

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Existing Button's default variant; inherits the theme's CSS variables.
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:40px; padding:8px 16px; background:hsl(var(--primary)); color:hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); border:0; border-radius:calc(var(--radius) - 2px); font-family:"DM Sans",system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; line-height:20px; transition:background-color 0.15s; } .ds-button:hover { background:hsl(var(--primary) / 0.9); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-button:disabled { pointer-events:none; opacity:0.5; }

components.name: Portal Profile Field
components.description: Scoped Profile field: 48px minimum height, 12px corners and foreground-derived control border. The portal-local override leaves the base Input unchanged.
components.css: .ds-portal-input { min-height:48px; width:100%; padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid hsl(var(--foreground) / 0.45); border-radius:12px; background:hsl(var(--background)); color:hsl(var(--foreground)); font-family:"DM Sans",system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:16px; transition:background-color 160ms,border-color 160ms,color 160ms,box-shadow 160ms; } .ds-portal-input::placeholder { color:hsl(var(--foreground) / 0.7); opacity:1; } .ds-portal-input:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color:hsl(var(--foreground)); } .ds-portal-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--portal-primary, hsl(var(--primary))); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-portal-input:disabled { cursor:not-allowed; opacity:0.5; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-portal-input { transition:none; } }

components.name: Public Primary Action
components.description: Landing and Login square action, with theme-local contrast fills and currentColor keyboard focus.
components.html: <button class="ds-public-action">Build my week <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14m-6-6 6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-public-action { --ds-action:hsl(var(--primary)); display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:2.5rem; min-height:56px; padding:0.875rem 1.5rem; border:0; border-radius:0; background:var(--ds-action); color:hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); font-family:"DM Sans",system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:1rem; font-weight:500; text-decoration:none; transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1),opacity 180ms ease; } :host-context(.theme-dark) .ds-public-action { --ds-action:color-mix(in srgb,hsl(var(--primary)),black 40%); } :host-context(.theme-bright) .ds-public-action { --ds-action:color-mix(in srgb,hsl(var(--primary)),black 30%); } .ds-public-action svg { width:20px; height:20px; transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-public-action:hover svg { transform:translateX(4px); } .ds-public-action:active { transform:scale(0.985); } .ds-public-action:focus-visible { outline:2px solid currentColor; outline-offset:5px; } .ds-public-action:disabled { cursor:wait; opacity:0.7; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-public-action,.ds-public-action svg { transition:none; } }

components.name: Public Example Day
components.description: Pressed weekday in the illustrative plan; weekday and session name remain visible at every width.
components.css: .ds-public-day { --ds-action:hsl(var(--primary)); position:relative; text-align:left; padding:0.875rem 0.5rem; min-height:92px; border:0; border-radius:0; background:transparent; color:hsl(var(--foreground)); font-family:"DM Sans",system-ui,sans-serif; transition:color 160ms ease; } :host-context(.theme-dark) .ds-public-day { --ds-action:color-mix(in srgb,hsl(var(--primary)),black 40%); } :host-context(.theme-bright) .ds-public-day { --ds-action:color-mix(in srgb,hsl(var(--primary)),black 30%); } .ds-public-day[aria-pressed="true"] { background:var(--ds-action); color:hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); } .ds-public-day:not([aria-pressed="true"]):hover { background:hsl(var(--secondary)); } .ds-public-day:focus-visible { outline:2px solid currentColor; outline-offset:5px; } .ds-public-day-name { display:block; font-size:0.8125rem; } .ds-public-day-session { display:block; font-size:0.9375rem; font-weight:500; margin-top:0.5rem; line-height:1.3; } @media(max-width:1050px) { .ds-public-day { min-height:76px; } } @media(max-width:760px) { .ds-public-day { min-height:80px; padding:0.75rem; } .ds-public-day-session { font-size:0.875rem; } } @media(max-width:420px) { .ds-public-day { padding:0.625rem 0.5rem; } } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-public-day { transition:none; } }

components.name: Public Masthead
components.description: Normal-flow public masthead with the shared track mark and public condensed wordmark. Full page adds theme and contextual links.
components.html: Running CoachLog in
components.css: .ds-public-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:1rem; height:88px; color:hsl(var(--foreground)); background:hsl(var(--background)); font-family:"DM Sans",system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:0.9375rem; } .ds-public-nav a { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; color:inherit; text-decoration:none; text-underline-offset:0.25em; } .ds-public-nav a:hover { text-decoration:underline; } .ds-public-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid currentColor; outline-offset:5px; } .ds-public-brand { gap:0.65rem; font-family:"RC Display","Arial Narrow",sans-serif; font-size:1.625rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-0.02em; } .ds-public-brand svg { width:30px; height:30px; flex:none; color:hsl(var(--primary)); } @media(max-width:760px) { .ds-public-nav { height:76px; } } @media(max-width:420px) { .ds-public-brand { gap:0.375rem; font-size:1.375rem; } .ds-public-brand svg { width:26px; height:26px; } .ds-public-nav { font-size:0.875rem; } } :host-context(.theme-dark) .ds-public-brand svg { color:color-mix(in srgb,hsl(var(--primary)),black 40%); } :host-context(.theme-bright) .ds-public-brand svg { color:color-mix(in srgb,hsl(var(--primary)),black 30%); }

narrative.overview: Descriptive record of the existing React/Tailwind system. Code remains the visual authority under AGENTS.md. Public Landing/Login use a photographic running publication vocabulary: real athlete imagery, RC Display condensed headings, square actions and an interactive example week. Shared body type, track mark and four palettes connect public pages to the portal; portal, onboarding and privacy composition remain separate.
keyCharacteristics: Serif headings and sans-serif body text
Photographic landing page; portal focused on sessions
Public Landing/Login: Barlow Condensed semibold, credited athlete photography and square actions
dos: Follow AGENTS.md and compare structural work with the agreed design or brief.
Do keep public composition and action overrides scoped to Landing and Login; preserve shared body type, theme switching and the separate privacy/portal systems.
Do retain visible final content under reduced motion and distinguish an illustrative week from an athlete's actual plan.
donts: Confuse a code capture with an audit or redesign.
